name: Heleieth Saffioti
shortBio: Brazilian Marxist feminist sociologist whose Women in Class Society analyzed the co-constitutive "knot" of patriarchy, racism, and capitalism in Latin America.
centralQuestion: How do patriarchy, racism, and peripheral capitalism interlock as a single structural "knot" rather than separate systems of oppression?

keyWorks.title: Women in Class Society (A Mulher na Sociedade de Classes)
keyWorks.description: Landmark Brazilian Marxist-feminist treatise demonstrating how capitalist class reproduction relies on domestic patriarchal subordination.

keyWorks.title: Gênero, patriarcado, violência
keyWorks.description: Formulates the patriarchy-racism-capitalism "knot" (nó) driving structural gender violence.
